name: Callow & Vex Patchwork Cargo Trouser
description: Not a manufactured product — these are second-hand cargo pants repaired and resold by the Callow & Vex depot stall in Meridian's Shelf market districts. Each pair is different: mismatched patches on the knees, replaced pocket panels in contrasting fabric, restitched seams. Structurally sound despite appearances. A patchwork pair in good condition is a minor point of pride on the Shelf.
what_it_says: You're on the Shelf and you're making it work — or you're from Tier 2 and buying into Shelf culture deliberately.
story_hooks: Experienced Shelf dwellers can sometimes identify the origin of a pair's patches — a distinctive corporate fabric on a knee panel might mean the original pants came from a specific employer.
Callow & Vex keeps rough records of what they take in; they've been quietly asked by investigators more than once to check if a specific pair passed through their stock.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian cargo pants with visible history — multiple fabric patches create an asymmetrical patchwork aesthetic across legs and pockets. Heavy, workwear silhouette with pronounced cargo pockets and reinforced paneling. Worn-in comfort paired with visible repair craftsmanship.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, straight-leg cut through hip and thigh with slight taper at ankle. Built for movement and layering; sits comfortably at natural waist with generous seat room. Designed to accommodate augmentation wear or thick underlayers.
physical_description.primary_material: Recycled composite cordura-blend base — salvaged industrial weave mixed with repurposed synth-cotton from secondary market sources. Patch panels in contrasting materials: ballistic mesh, treated leather scraps, recycled denim, synth-wool reinforcement.
physical_description.texture: Rough, tactile weave base with visible stitching. Patches create raised texture variation — some smooth leather, some ribbed mesh, some softer denim. Seams are thick and prominent, deliberately restitched for durability rather than aesthetics.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant warm gray-brown base with high-contrast patchwork: cream, rust, charcoal, faded indigo, and moss-green patches creating irregular pattern across knees and cargo pockets. Wear fading creates subtle striping along seams.
physical_description.closures: Heavy brass friction-fit waistband with traditional button fly (mismatched replacement button visible). Cargo pocket flaps secured with reinforced stitching; some pockets have magnetic snap replacements.
distinctive_features: Asymmetrical knee patches in three different materials
Replaced rear pocket panels in contrasting ballistic mesh
Visible Callow & Vex depot tag sewn inside waistband (faded orange)
Reinforced stress-point stitching in bright synthetic thread
Hidden interior stash pocket added during repair
Wear patterns show authentic use — scuffing at cuff, creasing at thigh
One cargo pocket replaced with salvaged synth-leather
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 salvage / Tier 3 functional — signals street-level practicality and acceptance of visible repair. Wearing patched cargo shows resourcefulness, not poverty; these are valued finds on the Shelf.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street-level subculture markers — worn by maintenance workers, Shelf market dwellers, salvage runners, and those who see beauty in functional repair. Indicates engagement with secondary economy and rejection of throwaway fashion. Point of pride for those who know Callow & Vex's reputation for structural integrity.
physical_description.condition_typical: Structurally sound with visible patching and wear. Not distressed for fashion — genuinely weathered from previous use and repair cycle. Each pair unique; expected to show multiple repair generations. Minor stains, fading, and seam stress are normal and acceptable.

image_prompt: Neo-noir fashion photography of worn patchwork cargo pants displayed on dark chrome mannequin or worn by Shelf market runner with visible augmentation. Close detail on asymmetrical knee patches in contrasting fabrics — cream, rust, indigo, mesh. Moody industrial lighting with accent light catching raised seams and patch texture. Gritty urban backdrop: corrugated metal, dim neon signage, rain-slicked concrete. Shallow depth of field on patch details.
